description: Membrane-axis geometry and per-subunit surface charge of the ARL6-bound bovine BBSome
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os, json
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}; OUT="/tmp/bbs9"; os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
AA3to1={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def fetch_cif(p):
    f=f"{OUT}/{p}.cif"
    if not os.path.exists(f):
        r=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.cif",headers=H,timeout=180); r.raise_for_status(); open(f,"w").write(r.text)
    return f
def parse_atom_site(path):
    cols=[];rows=[];reading=False
    for line in open(path):
        t=line.strip()
        if t.startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(t.split(".")[1].split()[0]); continue
        if cols and not reading:
            if t.startswith("#") or t=="" or t.startswith("_") or t.startswith("loop_"): continue
            reading=True
        if reading:
            if t.startswith("#") or t=="": break
            pp=t.split()
            if len(pp)==len(cols): rows.append(pp)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=cols)
def load(pid):
    df=parse_atom_site(fetch_cif(pid)); df=df[df["group_PDB"]=="ATOM"].copy()
    if "label_alt_id" in df: df=df[df["label_alt_id"].isin([".","A"])]
    for c in ["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]: df[c]=pd.to_numeric(df[c],errors="coerce")
    df["resnum"]=pd.to_numeric(df["auth_seq_id"],errors="coerce")
    df["chain"]=df["auth_asym_id"]; df["aa"]=df["label_comp_id"].map(AA3to1); df["elem"]=df["type_symbol"]
    return df.dropna(subset=["aa"]).reset_index(drop=True)
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'SE':1.90}
i_=np.arange(120)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*i_/120); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i_
SP=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)]
def sasa_atoms(xyz,elems,probe=1.4):
    r=np.array([RAD.get(e.upper(),1.7) for e in elems])+probe
    tree=cKDTree(xyz); out=np.zeros(len(xyz)); mx=r.max()
    for i,nb in enumerate(tree.query_ball_point(xyz,r+mx)):
        nb=np.array([j for j in nb if j!=i],int); pts=xyz[i]+SP*r[i]
        if len(nb):
            acc=(((pts[:,None,:]-xyz[nb][None,:,:])**2).sum(2)>=(r[nb]**2)[None,:]).all(1)
        else: acc=np.ones(len(pts),bool)
        out[i]=4*np.pi*r[i]**2*acc.mean()
    return out
MAXASA={'A':129,'R':274,'N':195,'D':193,'C':167,'E':223,'Q':225,'G':104,'H':224,'I':197,'L':201,'K':236,'M':224,'F':240,'P':159,'S':155,'T':172,'W':285,'Y':263,'V':174}

d=load("6VBV"); xyz=d[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values
bb=d[d.chain!="3"]; X=bb[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values
cen=X.mean(0); ev,evec=np.linalg.eigh(np.cov((X-cen).T)); n_thin=evec[:,0]
arl6=d[d.chain=="3"][["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values.mean(0)
n_mem=n_thin*np.sign((arl6-cen)@n_thin)
print("BBSome RMS extents (A):", np.round(np.sqrt(ev)[::-1],1),
      "| ARL6 offset along thin axis: %.1f A"%abs((arl6-cen)@n_thin))
sa=sasa_atoms(xyz,d.elem.values)
d=d.assign(sasa=sa, proj=(xyz-cen)@n_mem)
res=d.groupby(["chain","resnum"]).agg(aa=("aa","first"),sasa=("sasa","sum"),proj=("proj","mean")).reset_index()
res["rsa"]=res.sasa/res.aa.map(MAXASA); res["charge"]=res.aa.map({'K':1,'R':1,'D':-1,'E':-1}).fillna(0)
SUB={"0":"BBS18","1":"BBS1","2":"BBS2","3":"ARL6","4":"BBS4","5":"BBS5","7":"BBS7","8":"BBS8","9":"BBS9"}
res["subunit"]=res.chain.map(SUB)
exp=res[(res.rsa>0.25)&(res.chain!="3")].copy()
hi=exp.proj.quantile(0.75); lo=exp.proj.quantile(0.25)
print(f"surface residues {len(exp)}; membrane-side proj>{hi:.1f} A; distal proj<{lo:.1f} A")
def facechg(s=None):
    e=exp if s is None else exp[exp.subunit==s]
    top=e[e.proj>hi]; bot=e[e.proj<lo]
    return dict(subunit=s or "WHOLE", n_surf=len(e), n_mem=len(top), chg_mem=int(top.charge.sum()),
                dens_mem=round(float(top.charge.sum()/max(len(top),1)),3),
                n_far=len(bot), chg_far=int(bot.charge.sum()),
                dens_far=round(float(bot.charge.sum()/max(len(bot),1)),3))
tab=pd.DataFrame([facechg()]+[facechg(s) for s in ["BBS1","BBS2","BBS4","BBS5","BBS7","BBS8","BBS9","BBS18"]])
print("\n=== Surface charge, membrane-proximal vs distal face (6VBV BBSome:ARL6:GTP) ===")
print(tab.to_string(index=False))
t9=exp[exp.subunit=="BBS9"]
print(f"\nBBS9 exposed residues: {len(t9)} total; {len(t9[t9.proj>hi])} on membrane face "
      f"({100*len(t9[t9.proj>hi])/len(exp[exp.proj>hi]):.1f}% of that face), "
      f"{len(t9[t9.proj<lo])} on distal face ({100*len(t9[t9.proj<lo])/len(exp[exp.proj<lo]):.1f}%)")
print("BBS9 proj range: %.1f to %.1f A (median %.1f)"%(t9.proj.min(),t9.proj.max(),t9.proj.median()))
for s in ["BBS1","BBS2","BBS5","BBS7","BBS8","BBS9"]:
    v=exp[exp.subunit==s].proj; print(f"  {s}: median proj {v.median():6.1f}  IQR {v.quantile(.25):6.1f}..{v.quantile(.75):6.1f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
for s,c in zip(["BBS1","BBS2","BBS5","BBS7","BBS8","BBS9"],plt.cm.tab10.colors):
    axes[0].hist(exp[exp.subunit==s].proj,bins=np.arange(-45,50,4),histtype="step",lw=2,label=s,color=c,density=True)
axes[0].axvline(hi,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); axes[0].axvline(lo,ls=":",c="k",lw=1)
axes[0].set_xlabel("position along membrane axis (A, + = ARL6 side)")
axes[0].set_ylabel("density of exposed residues"); axes[0].legend(fontsize=8,ncol=2)
axes[0].set_title("Subunit position on the BBSome membrane axis (6VBV)")
b=tab[tab.subunit!="WHOLE"]; x=np.arange(len(b))
axes[1].bar(x-0.2,b.dens_mem,0.4,label="membrane-proximal quartile")
axes[1].bar(x+0.2,b.dens_far,0.4,label="distal quartile")
axes[1].set_xticks(x); axes[1].set_xticklabels(b.subunit,rotation=45); axes[1].axhline(0,c="k",lw=0.8)
axes[1].set_ylabel("net charge per exposed residue"); axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
axes[1].set_title("Surface charge density by face")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
res.to_csv(f"{OUT}/surface.csv",index=False)
